items.summary: Update the global navigation header to be fully transparent with a premium glassmorphism effect at the top of the page: backdrop blur 10–15px, very subtle white tint (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)), thin soft border (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)), and white navigation text. Remove the current solid/dark filled header background.

Implement scroll-based header styling: when the page is scrolled, slightly increase blur and opacity and add a very subtle darker tint (deep navy/charcoal at low opacity) while keeping the header glassy (not a solid bar).
Increase the header logo size to approximately 1.5× the current size while keeping alignment clean across breakpoints and ensuring it does not overlap navigation or push layout awkwardly.

Refine the Home page hero section to match a cinematic-but-clean luxury editorial style: use a sharp, high-resolution equestrian placeholder image (close-up leather saddle/bridle detail, warm brown tones, shallow depth of field, natural lighting), remove heavy/dark overlays, and apply only a very subtle top gradient for text readability while keeping the image crisp and visible.

Update hero typography and CTA button styling to match the requested direction: large elegant serif headline in white/soft warm white with a slight text shadow; generous spacing; primary button in warm gold; secondary button transparent with a white border; both buttons have a subtle hover lift animation (2–4px) with smooth transitions (avoid heavy scaling).

Restyle the Home page features/highlights cards as floating glass panels over a deep navy/charcoal section background: card background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop blur, thin soft border, subtle shadow, rounded corners, and a smooth hover lift of 2–4px. Remove/avoid heavy beige/grey blocks and avoid switching to ivory or light sections for this features area.

Enforce Home page section background consistency and spacing: reduce/replace alternating light backgrounds so the page uses mostly deep dark navy/charcoal with restrained transparent overlays; avoid white-heavy sections and flat grey sections; increase vertical spacing/breathing room between sections and slightly increase heading sizes where needed to maintain an editorial premium feel.
